title: Toybox After Hours: Closing Shift
about: Take the overnight toy-store cleanup shift. Return plushies, dragons, and robots to their places, repair the broken ones, and finish before sunrise.

Cycle which carried toy is active
Open or close the shop tools screen
Hide the first-shift guide; replay it from Settings
Pause, adjust settings, or open How to Play
